CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE K.NATARAJAN
ORAL ORDER

This petition is filed by the petitioners accused Nos.1 to 8 under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. for quashing the criminal proceedings in Spl. C.C.NO.56/2020 registered in Crime No.151/2012 by the Jayanagara Police and subsequently transferred to CCB police, Bengaluru, for the offences punishable under Sections 3, 4 and 5 of Prize Chits Money Circulation Schemes Act and Sections 420 and 120(b) of IPC, pending on the file of the XLVII Additional City Civil and Sessions Judge and Special Judge for CBI cases, Bengaluru (CCH-48).

sentences.text: 2. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioners, learned Additional SPP for the respondents respondent Nos.1 and 2.
The learned counsel appearing for respondent No.3 has remained absent.
The case of prosecution is that on the complaint of respondent No.3, the police registered the FIR.
It is alleged that the respondent invested money in the company run by the petitioners in the name and style of M/s. Vega Zeal Marketing Private Limited.
It is stated that the company is doing the network marketing business and that they can earn more money if they, invest the amount.
Accordingly, the respondent and others said to be assured that if they invest money, they will get good returns and gold coins, etc.

Accordingly, the respondent invested Rs.2,34,900/- by cheque,
and also got invested money through others.
Subsequently, the company cheated the respondent-complainant and not paid money as assured.
Therefore, they committed the offence.
The police registered the FIR.
Subsequently, the CCB Police took up investigation and filed charge sheet as against eight accused persons.
Being aggrieved by the same, the petitioners are before this Court.

Learned counsel for the petitioners has seriously contended that the amount was invested by the respondent-complainant and others in the company run by the petitioners where the petitioners are Mr Shrwan Sharma vs The State Of Karnataka on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143523247/
4 said to be the directors and the company was not made as accused as per the direction of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of ANEETA HADA VS. GODFATHER TRAVELS AND TOURS PRIVATE LIMITED reported in (2012)5 SCC 661 wherein it is held that without making the company as party-accused, the criminal proceedings is not maintainable against the directors of the company.

sentences.text: Therefore, prayed for quashing the proceedings.
In support of his arguments, the learned counsel has relied upon judgments of the Co-ordinate Benches of this Court.

5. Per contra, the Additional SPP for the respondents has seriously objected the petition and contended that the petitioners have already approached this court where the Coordinate Bench of this court has already dismissed their petition and once again, they have appeared in this NC:
2024:KHC:32535 petition which is not permissible.
The petitioners have cheated the complainant and other witnesses to the tune of more than Rs.1,70,00,000/-.
Therefore, they have to appear and face trial.
Hence, prayed for dismissing the petition.
6. Having heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties, perused the records.

7. On perusal of the same, as per the complaint made by the respondent No.3 to the Jayanagar police, FIR was registered for the offences punishable under Sections 3, 4 and 5 of Prize Chits and Money Circulation Schemes (Banning) Act, 1978 and Sections 420 and 120(B) of IPC.

sentences.text:
Subsequently,
the CCB police took up investigation and filed the charge sheet.
The charge sheet shows the offence against the petitioner-accused Nos. 1 to 8.
Though accused No.1 said to be the founder director of the company, but the company called M/s. Vega Zeal Marketing Private Limited, was not made as party accused No.1.

Though the petitioners have already approached this Court in Criminal NC:
2024:KHC:32535 Petition No.4893/2014, which was dismissed by the Co- ordinate Bench on 13.02.2019. I have perused the said order, where the point of law has not been discussed and it is only stated that the accused cheated the complainant and the matter is required for investigation.
However, liberty was a reserved to approach the trial court seeking discharge.

However, in view of the judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Aneeta Hada, Supra, when the company is not made as an accused, the directors are not made responsible and the criminal proceedings against them is not sustainable in law.

8. The Co-ordinate Benches of this Court in the case of Venkata Subbaiah Eranty and others Vs.
Puttarangappa M. Srinivas & Anr. Vs. State of Karnataka (Criminal Revision Petition No.139/2024 dated 07.05.2024), in the case of M. Srinivas & Anr. Vs. State of Karnataka (in Crl. P. No.1836/2022 dated 15.03.2022 and in the case M.Srinivas & Anr. Vs. State of karnataka (in Crl. P. No.2750/2022 dated 28.03.2022), NC: 2024:KHC:32535 have also taken similar view and quashed the criminal proceedings as the company was not made as party- accused.

Hence,
the charge sheet and the criminal proceedings are liable to be quashed.
9. Accordingly, I pass the following order:
(i) The criminal petition is allowed.
